ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white/yellowish) and 35% low-intensity pixels (black) localized primarily at the margins and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad light-colored contiguous blobs occupy the central regions of both lobes. The left lobe contains a large white field with dark mottling near the notch. The right lobe exhibits a similar light field interrupted by multiple dark diagonal linear streaks extending towards the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with an estimated interior angle of 75 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-4 pixel height) across the entire boundary, increasing in jaggedness towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve profile along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning from horizontal lateral tips to a steep decline at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear disruptions are present: three distinct diagonal rake marks on the right lobe and several shorter vertical linear marks on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Trailing edge shows significant jagged wear and minor chipping. Linear dark marks break the continuity of the white pigmentation across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-tan hue overlaying the light-pigmented ventral regions, deviating from pure white intensity.
